papers.s2: Fair in level and lessons 4-6 get a reasonable share, but the paper keeps answering itself: the grammar blanks and the writing items reappear as whole sentences in the reading and order parts (的, 什么, 哪, 会, 不是), so a careful student scores far above their real level. Listening is easy (dialog questions repeat the heard words), and some items use non-book Chinese (几个人, 二岁). It would not feel like a real exam until cross-part repetition is removed.
papers.mid2: Lessons 9-15 are covered fairly evenly and the item mix looks like an HSK 1 paper, but about a dozen grammar and fill items are given away by the same sentence printed in the reply or text section (在哪儿工作, 都是学生, 看见我的猫, 认识你很高兴, 坐出租车, 坐飞机来的). Lesson 10 measure word 本 is tested twice in the same frame, and the dialogs repeat the reply items word for word. Reading and writing are about right in difficulty; listening is too easy because the questions echo the audio.
papers.final: The length and spread look like a real final, but the paper is built from a small pool of sentences that come back three or four times (你家有几口人/三口人, 你爸爸是医生吗, 小猫在椅子下面, 我们去吃饭吧, 我是坐飞机来的), so many grammar blanks are answered by the listening or reading parts. Several fill items have two grammatical answers, three order items are broken (去我去学校看书, 好几点, 老师您好 vs 您好老师), and the meaning and pick parts skip lessons 9-13 while order skips lessons 3-5. Grammar is far too easy once the repetition is noticed.

rules: Keep one index of every sentence used in a paper (heard, shown, option or tile, punctuation stripped) and never use a sentence twice; drop any fill, blank or order item whose full sentence or answer phrase (e.g. 三本书, 买了不少衣服) is seen or heard anywhere else in the paper, including reply options.

Check every fill/blank distractor by substitution and reject any that makes a grammatical sentence: no noun of the same class for a noun slot (老师 for 妈妈, 猫 for 钱, 吃饭 after 在), no 吗 in a 吧 suggestion, no 这/那 before a bare noun, no 都 before 有, no 身体 with 天气.

Build order items only from single-clause lines without internal ！，。; never produce two identical tiles; run a check for a second valid order (您好老师, 你有几个家人, 我住在北京三年了) and keep the answer's punctuation.
Do not test the same answer word with the same frame twice in one paper (本 in fill and blank, 的 in fill and blank) and do not reuse a listening dialog as a reply or text item.
Judge texts must be one speaker's statement and the claim must not change modality (想去 vs 去); two-speaker exchanges go to reply or text, never to judge.

All options of one question must share language and type (no 'ninety-nine' among sentences, no 'Both' or 'We don't know' mixed with Chinese names), and generated Chinese must be book-correct (两岁 not 二岁, 几口人 not 几个人).
Balance each kind across lessons: in the final, meaning and pick skip lessons 9-13, order skips 3-5 and hand skips 13-14.
